summary.headline: Betrothal and Travel Indications
summary.text: Discussion of betrothal indications, including Venus under the rays and annual profections involving the ascendant and seventh sign. Chapter XXVII then begins instructions on travel and journeys, emphasizing the ninth house, its lord, Mars, the part of journey, dignities, fortunes, malefics, and applications to the ascendant lord.
